# PrayCalc — App Store & Play Store Listing

## App Name

**PrayCalc — Prayer Times & Adhan**

## Short Description (80 chars max)

Accurate Islamic prayer times, Adhan, Qibla & Ramadan tracker.

## Full Description

PrayCalc gives you accurate, GPS-based Islamic prayer times with beautiful adhan
reminders — built for Muslims who want a reliable, distraction-free app.

**Prayer Times**
- GPS-accurate times for every city in the world
- Supports all major calculation methods: ISNA, MWL, Egypt, Umm al-Qura, Tehran, Karachi
- Dynamic twilight angles (PrayCalc Dynamic Method) for high-latitude accuracy
- Qiyam (Tahajjud) time included
- Hanafi Asr option

**Adhan & Reminders**
- Built-in adhan library with authentic recordings
- Per-prayer sound settings: Adhan, Beep, Vibrate, Silent, or Off
- Custom agenda reminders before or after any prayer
- Intelligent rescheduling that survives app restarts

**Qibla Compass**
- Live compass pointing toward the Kaaba from anywhere in the world

**Ramadan**
- Suhoor (Fajr) and Iftar (Maghrib) times
- Fasting tracker for all 30 days
- Quran progress tracker (30 Juz)
- Days-to-Eid countdown

**Quran**
- Surah audio playback with authentic reciters
- Background playback with lock screen controls
- Verse display overlay

**TV Display**
- Full TV app for Android TV and Amazon Fire TV
- Masjid mode with iqamah display and announcements
- Adhan overlay, ambient screensaver, live stream integration
- Pair from your phone in seconds

**macOS & Desktop**
- Full desktop app with system tray integration
- Prayer time notifications at the right moment
- Quiet, always-available

**Privacy First**
- No account required
- No ads
- All settings stored locally on your device

## Store IDs

Bundle/package IDs below are for the current React Native apps (`mobile/`, `tv/`), not the
archived Flutter app. Mobile keeps the Flutter app's original ID so its store listings
continue rather than fork into new ones (see `mobile/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md` FGAP-08).

| Platform | App | App ID |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apple App Store | Mobile (`mobile/`) | `com.praycalc.praycalcApp` |
| Apple tvOS App Store | TV (`tv/`) | `com.ummeco.praycalc.tv` |
| Google Play | Mobile | `com.praycalc.praycalcApp` |
| Google Play (Android TV) | TV | `com.ummeco.praycalc.tv` |
| Amazon Appstore (Fire TV) | TV | `com.ummeco.praycalc.tv` |
